children: World launches its standalone onchain prediction market at world.xyz on Solana, opening sports, crypto, politics and culture markets to over 1 million waitlisted users. Chainlink provides the market resolution infrastructure, placing LINK at the center of a new enterprise adoption channel.

The launch extends Chainlink's oracle usage into prediction markets, a fast-growing vertical where resolution quality determines market integrity. Thousands of markets resolving on Chainlink data create recurring demand for oracle services, and LINK reserve fee conversion ties that activity to token accrual. Revenue scale from the platform is not yet stated, so the adoption channel is concrete while its financial contribution remains unquantified.
